title.zh: 重新划拨第2301号共和国法项下用于东内格罗斯省Jimalalud市镇礼堂建设的若干款项的法案
title.en: An Act Reappropriating Certain Sums Under Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Three Hundred and One for the Construction of the Jimalalud Municipal Hall in the Province of Negros Oriental
title.orig: An Act Reappropriating Certain Sums Under Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Three Hundred and One for the Construction of the Jimalalud Municipal Hall in the Province of Negros Oriental

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2888_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sums appropriated under items (c), (d) and (k) on pages 440 and 441, subparagraph 38, paragraph d, Section two of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-three hundred and one, in the total amount of twenty-five thousand pesos, are hereby reappropriated for the construction of the Jimalalud Municipal Hall in the Municipality of Jimalalud, Province of Negros Oriental.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
